== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]] (<code>1261_33</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” (23 July 2010). Text layer composited into the text box by hand because the render raises the banner (CardMaker raised-text bug).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Jabba's Palace: Rancor Pit|Rancor Pit. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
